coverageNote: Coverage: user Skill directories, enabled Claude plugins and Codex plugin cache inventories. Project directories are included only with an explicit project root. Cache presence does not prove loading; admin and remotely supplied Skills are not inspected.
measurementNote: Static estimates use 4 ASCII characters or 1 Unicode scalar per token, not a model tokenizer. Catalog and SKILL.md are separate views; referenced files and actual session loading are not measured.
